description.value: A-1 Pizza is a locally owned fast-food pizza shop in Surrey, BC, specializing in Punjabi-style pizzas with a distinctive Desi-influenced flavour profile. The menu features a broad range of vegetarian options alongside customizable pies, drawing a loyal local following. Cyclists will find ample free parking on site, with both a parking lot and parking garage noted in customer reviews.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 46m; wave (7 spaces) at 83m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this pizza restaurant at 13651 100 Avenue with a recent check_date of 2025-05-21 and looks_closed=false, indicating a currently operating business. The website at a1pizzabc.com confirms an active Punjabi-style pizza operation offering pickup and delivery; however, the website consistently references 'Surrey' while the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' — 100 Avenue is a Surrey street, so the community tag appears erroneous. A customer review explicitly notes 'a tonne of veggie options,' confirming vegetarian availability; no bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but 100 Avenue is a Surrey street and the website repeatedly references 'Surrey' — the community tag appears to be incorrect.
OSM name is 'A-1Pizza' (no space) while the website uses 'A-1 Pizza'; minor formatting discrepancy.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating pizza restaurant with a live website, recent OSM check_date (2025-05-21), and no closure indicators. A useful food stop for touring cyclists.
